skill.displayName: 企业所得税纳税调整核对（免费版）

version.changelog: 正文新增「免费网页版」入口；名称取自 SKILL.md

llm.summary: This skill is a local, narrowly scoped checker for Chinese enterprise income tax adjustment tables, with no evidence of network access, persistence, credential use, or hidden behavior.

dimensions.detail: Use of Read and Bash is proportionate to invoking the bundled local Node checker. The scripts use Node standard libraries and no network, shell spawning, credential stores, or broad filesystem scanning were found.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No install hook, package dependency installation, remote retrieval, or setup-time execution was found in the artifact; the package consists of SKILL.md, a runner, an engine, and a sample JSON file.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions tell the user to run a local Node script with either a sample or an input file; the code reads only the specified input file and rejects insufficient or malformed table material rather than inventing conclusions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence mechanism, background worker, scheduled task, privilege escalation, file mutation, memory writing, or tool hijacking behavior was found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is deterministic checking of enterprise income tax adjustment table arithmetic and consistency, and the inspected code implements that scope with explicit lists of checks performed and checks not performed.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you need a Chinese enterprise income tax adjustment table arithmetic checker. It is a free local subset and explicitly does not check several tax-limit and legal-validity issues, so users should not treat a clean result as full tax compliance advice.
llm.findings:
[AE1] expected: The referenced scripts/run.mjs file is present in the artifact and was fully inspected; referencing the local runner from usage examples is consistent with the skill purpose.
[SQP-3] expected: The Chinese-language interface is consistent with a China enterprise income tax adjustment table checker and is disclosed in the skill name, summary, tags, and descriptions; it is not a security concern here.
[SDI-4] unexpected: One inline comment mentions pasted contract text, while the implemented behavior and user-facing help require tax adjustment table text with headers. This is a minor documentation inconsistency, not hidden capability or unsafe behavior.
[AIG SARIF] expected: The static scan reported no T01-T09 results, aligning with artifact inspection showing no prompt hijacking, remote execution, persistence, privilege escalation, or insecure dependency behavior.
